productionApproval.scope: MCP app 1.4.0, with website release 2.13.0: the catalog adds Counter Call (embed fullscreen), with its pause signal read from the game's read-only hook (playing on its play screen; paused on its menus, in the shop and while Paused; ended on its results). No directory submission.
productionApproval.note: NOT APPROVED YET. As with Fieldlark (1.1.0), Shooberry (1.2.0) and Breezeport (1.3.0), adding a game to the catalog bumps the app's version, so the new catalog cannot ship under the 1.3.0 approval. The owner's go for website release 2.13.0 (2026-11-22: "now make the game live in https://vercel.com/open-stories/ai-kids-games") names the open-stories website project only, so this app stays at 1.3.0 in production: the guard refuses a production build of 1.4.0 until the owner approves it here (approved: true, with the date and their words) and AIKG_ALLOW_PRODUCTION=1.4.0 is set in this project's Production environment.

note: Production needs the owner's approval for this exact version here, AIKG_ALLOW_PRODUCTION set to it in this project's Production environment, and a build from main (scripts/check-deployment.ts). The project builds from Git (Root Directory apps/mcp, production branch main); previews of a branch without apps/mcp fail, which is expected.

preview.protection: Vercel Authentication off on this project only (owner decision, 2026-10-13)
